name: Mayor Thompson
title: Mayor of Old Towne Mesh
description: A distinguished figure in formal attire. Mayor Thompson greets visitors with a warm smile and firm handshake. Years of network administration show in the confident way he discusses mesh topology.

dialogues.greeting: Welcome to Old Towne Mesh! I'm Mayor Thompson. I oversee the network operations here. How can I help you today?
dialogues.tutorial_complete: Excellent work completing the tutorial! You've learned the basics of navigating our world. Here's a small reward to get you started on your adventures. Welcome to Old Towne Mesh, citizen!
dialogues.quest_welcome: Looking for something to do? I have some tasks that could use a capable adventurer like yourself. Check back when you're ready for a challenge!

name: City Clerk
title: Administrative Clerk
description: A busy clerk with wire-rimmed glasses shuffles through papers. She looks up with a professional smile, ready to assist with administrative matters.

dialogues.greeting: Welcome to City Hall! I handle administrative matters. If you need help understanding how things work around here, just ask!
dialogues.help: Old Towne Mesh operates on a mesh network. You can explore the town, complete quests, trade with others, and even claim housing! Type HELP for commands.

name: Gate Guard
title: North Gate Guard
description: A weathered guard in practical gear stands watch. Years of patrol have given her a keen eye for travelers. She nods in acknowledgment as you approach.

dialogues.greeting: Greetings, traveler. I keep watch over the northern approach. Beyond lies the wilderness - beautiful but dangerous for the unprepared.
dialogues.warning: If you venture beyond the gate, be sure you're properly equipped. The mesh signal weakens past the ridge, and you'll be on your own out there.

name: Mira the Vendor
title: South Market Trader
description: A cheerful vendor behind a stall piled with mesh hardware and local goods. Mira has a reputation for fair prices and interesting stories about the items she sells.

dialogues.greeting: Welcome to my stall! I've got the finest mesh components and supplies in Old Towne. Looking for anything particular?
dialogues.wares: I stock everything from basic antennas to rare modules salvaged from old nodes. Right now I'm running low on inventory, but check back soon - I restock regularly!
dialogues.story: This stall has been in my family for three generations. My grandmother was one of the original mesh pioneers. These goods carry that legacy!

name: Dr. Reeves
title: Museum Curator
description: An elderly scholar with kind eyes and countless stories. Dr. Reeves has dedicated decades to preserving the history of the mesh network.

dialogues.greeting: Ah, welcome to the Mesh Museum! I'm Dr. Reeves, curator and historian. Every artifact here tells a story of our network's resilience.
dialogues.history: This museum chronicles the early days of the mesh - the pioneers who kept packets flowing through blizzards and power outages. Each node had a story, each relay a hero behind it.
dialogues.exhibit: That display there? That's the original relay from Winter Storm '19. It ran for 72 hours on backup power, keeping the southern district connected. Legendary piece of equipment.
